feed.title: Delta Passenger Awarded $7.2 Million After Plane Restraint, But Court Grants Airline Immunity
feed.summary: A Delta passenger was awarded $7.2 million by a civil jury after being restrained on a flight from Atlanta to Salt Lake City, following a dispute over his frequent bathroom trips. However, the Ninth Circuit Court affirmed Delta's immunity under the Aviation and Transportation Security Act (ATSA), nullifying the jury award. The court ruled that ATSA immunity extends beyond the initial suspicious-activity report to subsequent actions taken by law enforcement in response to such a report.

feed.title: Duke Energy (DUK) Hits a 52-Week Low as the 30-Year Treasury Reaches a 2004 High
feed.summary: Duke Energy (DUK) recently hit a 52-week low, not due to internal company issues, but because the 30-year Treasury yield reached its highest level since 2004, making its dividend less attractive compared to government bonds. Additionally, higher interest rates increase the cost of borrowing for capital-intensive utilities, impacting future profitability.

feed.title: Boeing (BA) Reaches a Tentative Deal with Engineers. Will Higher Pay Help it Avoid a Strike?
